03 / 09 · Little PlayKicks · Where early learning meets active play

Early Years & Fundamentals

Since 2020 we’ve worked with preschools and Montessori centres across Christchurch. What began as football has grown into Little PlayKicks: a complete motor-skills, multi-sport introduction that builds movement, confidence and a lifelong love of being active.

Bring Proteus to your centre
THE PROTEUS WAY / PRESCHOOLS · AGES 2–5

WHO IT’S FOR

Preschools, Montessori and early learning centres, and educators looking to introduce active learning through sport.

01

Mini Movers · Ages 2–3

A warm, nurturing introduction to movement and play: balance, simple instructions and sensory play.

02

PlayKickers · Ages 3–4

More structured activities blending football skills and all-sport coordination: kicking, dribbling, throwing, catching and agility.

03

Little Legends · Ages 4–5

A confident step towards school sport and clubs: ball control, gameplay basics, teamwork and independence.

  • Since 2020Partnering with early learning centres
  • 30–45 minSessions led by qualified coaches

HERE TO HELP

GOOD
QUESTIONS.

Ask us something else
What ages is Little PlayKicks for?

Ages 2 to 5, in three stages: Mini Movers (ages 2–3), PlayKickers (ages 3–4) and Little Legends (ages 4–5).

What happens in a session?

A typical session moves from a warm-up and imaginative story play through motor-skills stations, football fundamentals, throwing, catching and all-sport drills, and confidence and teamwork challenges, to a cooldown and achievement moment.

Can you come to our centre?

Yes. We work with preschools, Montessori and early learning centres across Christchurch. Get in touch to bring Proteus to your centre.

Which programme is right for us?

Tell us who the programme is for, your sport and what you want to achieve. Our team can discuss the options for an individual player, preschool, school, club, community organisation or retirement village.
